*{{response.school_name}} WhatsApp Bot Menu*

Aap niche diye gaye commands bhej sakte hain:

1. /fees - Fee balance aur online payment link
2. /attendance - Aaj ki attendance aur monthly percentage
3. /homework - Aaj ka class homework
4. /notice - School ke jaruri circular aur notices
